description: DB integration: migrations apply on a clean schema and create the three tables with the dismissal uniqueness constraint
DB integration: portal query returns only live notices (before start hidden, within window shown, after end hidden, open-ended shown)
DB integration: audience resolution for all, explicit client, and tag targets; a client outside the audience gets nothing
DB integration: tenant isolation — a notice in one tenant never returned to another tenant's user
DB integration: dismissal hides the notice for that user only, persists, is idempotent, and is cleared when the notice is edited
DB integration: critical notice is never returned as dismissible and dismiss on it is refused
DB integration: create, update (targets replaced), and delete (targets and dismissals removed) round trip
Permission guard: user without settings:update cannot create/update/delete; client portal user cannot call MSP actions; list requires settings:read
Validation unit: link scheme allowlist rejects javascript:, data:, and protocol-relative; accepts https and relative path; end-before-start and over-length rejected
Locale resolution unit: translated locale wins, missing locale falls back to default
Component: notice bar renders severity variants, plain-text message with safe link, dismiss only when dismissible, collapses past three
Component: settings dialog disables dismissible for critical and shows audience pickers by selected type
E2E: MSP creates a notice for a client; client user sees it on the portal, dismisses it, reloads and it stays hidden; user of another client never sees it
